---
description: 'Use when creating, updating, reviewing or archiving implementation plans under .ai/plans. Covers the lifecycle, the evidence standard and the archive footer.'
applyTo: '.ai/plans/**'
---

Follow [.ai/rules/plans.md](../../.ai/rules/plans.md) — it is the single source of truth for plans.

Key points: at most one plan in `active/`; plans are git-ignored and never proposed for a commit; record
exact commands and output; never tick partial work; never rewrite earlier recorded output.
